source_title: A Learning Journal Turns Isolation Into Method
summary: This July 22, 2020 Big Think interview adds an early pandemic-era positive education method: the learning journal turns forced isolation into self-assessment practice, with teachers recast as coaches who widen strategy rather than supply answers.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Students need enough space and autonomy for self-reflection and self-assessment before deliberate improvement becomes possible.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source does not repeat the trust-before-self-control mechanism directly, but it supplies a later practical counterpart: self-reflection requires an educational environment where inward attention and autonomous practice are possible.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: COVID disruption becomes a training ground for meta-learning rather than only a lost-schooling interval.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The interview is an earlier, narrower education-method recurrence of the living-school idea that crisis can train thought processes instead of merely delivering doctrine.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Add the learning journal as a positive counter-form inside the education lens: students choose a concrete goal, record process, collect observations and data, and learn to revise strategy rather than merely comply with assignments.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Education owns the soul-formation mechanism because the source is about how learning environments train self-assessment and agency. Living School owns the broader future-making school; Game Theory owns strategy under uncertainty only when the active frame is player incentives.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this 2020 Big Think clip as an earlier dated source for Jiang's positive meta-learning method before the later 2026 creativity interview develops teacher redundancy, psychological profiles, and student agency.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: The source should update Education chronology rather than become a standalone learning-journal page unless later sources show the journal itself becoming a reusable concept beyond this short clip.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Mention only if a later living-school pass needs an earlier practical example of crisis pedagogy: pandemic disruption becomes a chance to train self-assessment, observation, and learning strategy.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Keep the main extension in Education. Living School should not absorb every education method unless it directly supports psychohistory, future-making, or dark-age thought formation.

new_lens_seeds.title: Learning Journal As Meta-Learning Device
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A learner becomes able to improve when the act of learning is made visible: a concrete goal, a recorded process, and observations or data turn vague effort into a strategy that can be inspected and changed.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism can apply beyond COVID schooling, but this single short source is not yet enough to justify a public concept separate from Education As A Soul Game.

chronology_notes.note: On 2020-07-22, Jiang frames first-wave COVID school disruption as an opening for self-assessment and meta-learning rather than only as lost classroom time.
This is an earlier dated positive education-method source than the later 2026 Creativity interview: it already defines teacher value through coaching, strategy suggestion, and student self-diagnosis.
